command.source:
(o/definst voice [freq 440 amp 0.036 dur 3.2]
  (* amp (o/env-gen (o/perc 0.008 dur)) (o/mix [(o/sin-osc freq) (* 0.18 (o/sin-osc (* freq 2.01)))])))
(def metro (o/metronome 122))
(av/session
  (av/pattern :melody 16
    (o/play
      (o/at (metro 0) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 74)))
      (o/at (metro 5.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 69)))
      (o/at (metro 10) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 77)))
      (o/at (metro 14.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 76)))))
  (av/visual {:intensity 0.9 :feedback 0.2}))

(o/definst voice [freq 440 amp 0.05 dur 1.2]
  (* amp (o/env-gen (o/perc 0.008 dur)) (o/mix [(o/sin-osc freq) (* 0.18 (o/sin-osc (* freq 2.01)))])))
(def metro (o/metronome 122))
(av/session
  (av/pattern :melody 8
    (o/play
      (o/at (metro 0) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 74)))
      (o/at (metro 1.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 69)))
      (o/at (metro 3) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 76)))
      (o/at (metro 4) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 77)))
      (o/at (metro 6.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 72)))))
  (av/gesture :drop) (av/launch :current {:transition :dissolve :beats 4}) (av/visual {:intensity 1.1 :feedback 0.1}))

(o/definst voice [freq 440 amp 0.095 dur 0.23]
  (* amp (o/env-gen (o/perc 0.008 dur)) (o/mix [(o/sin-osc freq) (* 0.12 (o/sin-osc (* freq 2.0)))])))
(def metro (o/metronome 122))
(av/session
  (av/pattern :bass 4
    (o/play
      (o/at (metro 0.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 38)))
      (o/at (metro 1.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 38)))
      (o/at (metro 2.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 33)))
      (o/at (metro 3.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 36)))))
  (av/variation {:density 1 :seed 93}) (av/visual {:intensity 1.15 :symmetry 6}))

(o/definst voice [freq 440 amp 0.047 dur 1.0]
  (* amp (o/env-gen (o/perc 0.008 dur)) (o/mix [(o/sin-osc freq) (* 0.18 (o/sin-osc (* freq 2.01)))])))
(def metro (o/metronome 122))
(av/session
  (av/pattern :melody 8
    (o/play
      (o/at (metro 0) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 74)))
      (o/at (metro 1.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 77)))
      (o/at (metro 2.75) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 81)))
      (o/at (metro 4) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 76)))
      (o/at (metro 5.5) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 77)))
      (o/at (metro 7) (voice :freq (o/midi->hz 72)))))
  (av/launch :cathedral {:transition :iris :beats 8}) (av/layer :afterglow 0.18) (av/visual {:symmetry 8 :intensity 1.2 :feedback 0.12}))

#+TITLE: PELAGIC · a live audiovisual descent

* The performance
A quiet signal becomes a current.
The current becomes a cathedral.
The cathedral dissolves into light.

Play on the stage, or type g p.
C-Enter evaluates this live buffer.
g s stops; g v opens the stage.

* Overtone / Beam Lisp
Change the notes, the envelope,
or the groove. Evaluate. The new
pattern enters on the next bar.

#+begin_src beam-lisp :id lanterns
(o/definst glass
  [freq 440 amp 0.07 dur 2.6]
  (* amp
     (o/env-gen (o/perc 0.008 dur))
     (o/mix
       [(o/sin-osc freq)
        (* 0.24 (o/sin-osc (* freq 2.01)))])))

(def metro (o/metronome 122))

(av/session
  (av/configure {:space 0.52 :echo 0.38})
  (av/pattern :melody 4
    (o/play
      (o/at (metro 0)
        (glass :freq (o/midi->hz (o/note :D5))))
      (o/at (metro 1.5)
        (glass :freq (o/midi->hz (o/note :A4))))
      (o/at (metro 2.5)
        (glass :freq (o/midi->hz (o/note :E5)))))))
#+end_src

* Shadertone
The stage is a GLSL fragment shader.
iGlobalTime / iResolution / iMouse
iOvertoneVolume / iChannel0 (FFT + wave)
iChannel1 (the previous frame)

Add a begin_src glsl block here.
C-Enter hot-swaps a valid shader.
A broken shader keeps the last image.

* Two decks
A is the atmospheric harmonic field.
B is the pulse and melodic fragments.
Equal-power crossfade; three-band EQ;
filter, space, echo, swing and master.

Import local audio into either deck.
Set the source BPM to sync it.
CUE / SET / beat loops / quarter-second jog.
Movement buttons jump on the shared clock.
REC saves the live audio + shader.
WAV exports the original score.

* Leave no trace
